Role Summary 
 KDCI Outsourcing is looking for a Web QA specialist to ensure the quality, functionality, and reliability of web applications through thorough manual and automated testing. You'll work closely with developers to catch issues before they reach production.
 Key Responsibilities 

• Design, write, and execute test plans and test cases for web applications

• Perform manual and automated testing across browsers and devices

• Identify, document, and track bugs through to resolution

• Collaborate with developers and product owners to clarify requirements

• Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites

• Verify fixes and conduct regression testing before releases

 Requirements
 Requirements 

• 2+ years of experience in web application QA/testing

• Experience with manual testing methodologies and test case design

• Familiarity with automated testing tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright)

• Understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile practices

• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills

 Nice-to-Haves 

• Experience with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured)

• Basic scripting knowledge (JavaScript, Python)

• Familiarity with bug tracking tools (Jira, TestRail)

 Highlights
 Ensure high-quality web applications through manual, automated, and regression testing.
